title: Lena and the Ghost
premise: Yara Crane has spent six years erasing herself after fleeing the Meridian Group, a deniable intelligence cell that trained her and then ordered her death. When a burner phone rings with the voice of her dead mentor, Tomas, she learns he faked his demise to warn her: Meridian is hunting its former assets one by one, and her name is next. With help from a ragtag crew of other escaped assets—a forger, a hacker, a defected analyst—Yara stops running and starts dismantling the network from within, trading her anonymity for justice. In the end, she exposes Meridian's patron at the phantom embassy, buries Tomas for real, and chooses a found family over the invisibility that once kept her alive.
about_author: Mirabel Winterbourne is the pen name of a former foreign correspondent who spent a decade filing dispatches from cities that preferred not to be named. She writes thrillers about people who live in the gaps between official stories.

chapters.title: The Go-Bag Rule
chapters.summary: POV Yara. Establishes her life as an embassy fixer: polished lies, packed bag, three exit routes memorized. A routine document burn goes wrong when she spots her own alias in a kill file. Emotional beat: controlled paranoia cracking into dread.

chapters.title: A Voice from the Cold
chapters.summary: POV Yara. The burner phone rings—Tomas, her mentor, officially dead for two years. He warns that Meridian is liquidating former assets and gives her a rendezvous she doesn't trust. Emotional beat: grief weaponized into suspicion.

chapters.title: Dead Men Dial Twice
chapters.summary: POV alternating Yara and Nadia, a Meridian analyst who begins questioning the asset recall orders. Yara verifies Tomas's voice against old recordings while dodging a surveillance tail. Emotional beat: hope arriving dressed as a trap.

chapters.title: The Forger's Kitchen
chapters.summary: POV Yara. She seeks out Dez, a disgraced Meridian forger living under three identities, who reluctantly agrees to help after recognizing the kill-file format. First hint of found family forming. Emotional beat: wary solidarity over shared scars.

chapters.title: What the Embassy Buys
chapters.summary: POV Nadia. She traces payments revealing the phantom embassy is Meridian's laundering front and that its director, Voss, personally signed Yara's termination. Emotional beat: complicity curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: Rendezvous with a Ghost
chapters.summary: POV Yara. The meeting with Tomas is ambushed—he was bait, or so it seems; he escapes wounded, proving he's real but compromised. Yara realizes Meridian let her find him to map her allies. Emotional beat: betrayal and fierce protectiveness.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: POV Yara and ensemble. Meridian strikes: Dez's safehouse burns, the hacker Kip is nearly taken, and the crew scatters. Yara decides running is over—they go on offense. Emotional beat: loss transmuted into purpose.

chapters.title: Inside the Machine
chapters.summary: POV Nadia. Using her access, Nadia feeds Yara the archive of every erased asset, including proof Voss ordered Tomas's original 'death.' The plan forms: leak everything during the embassy's sealed gala. Emotional beat: quiet courage before the storm.

chapters.title: The Gala
chapters.summary: POV Yara. Climax. Disguised inside the embassy event, Yara confronts Voss, triggers the archive leak as security closes in, and faces Tomas forced to act against her—until he turns on Voss instead. Blood, glass, and broadcasted truth. Emotional beat: fury and sacrifice.

chapters.title: Lena's Table
chapters.summary: POV Yara, months later. Meridian is gutted by scandal; Voss vanishes into legal fog, but the survivors are free. At a small café under her real name—Lena—she sits with Dez, Kip, Nadia, and a recovering Tomas. Emotional beat: peace earned, family chosen.
